args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks – rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the v2.3.1 deploy, checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 18%. The staging build v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy. I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all regions. After the rollback, the service reports healthy on v2.3.0 in all three regions with an error rate of 0.2%. Next steps: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression, and look into why it was promoted even though the staging RC was unhealthy.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened the SEV2 incident.

- **Version chosen:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. The bad deploy, v2.3.1, was unhealthy in production, and its staging build (v2.3.1-rc) was unhealthy too.
- **Rollback:** us-east, us-west and eu-west are all on v2.3.0. After the rollback the service reports healthy, and the error rate dropped from 18% to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 (SEV2, checkout-api) is open and has paged on-call. It describes the failure, the rollback and the current health. It also lists two follow-ups: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure, and find out why v2.3.1 reached production when its staging build was unhealthy.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
